1.1: Ellu devarim sheen lahem shiur. happea, vehabbikkurim, vehareayon, ugemilut chasadim, vetalmud tora. ellu devarim sheadam ochel perotehen baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba. kibbud av vaem, ugemilut chasadim, vahavaat shalom ben adam lachavero, vetalmud tora keneged kullam:
1.2: En pochatin lappea mishshishshim, veaf al pi sheamru en lappea shiur. hakkol lefi godel hassade, ulefi rov haaniyyim, ulefi rov haanava:
1.3: Notnin pea mittechillat hassade umeemtzaah. rabbi shimon omer, uvilvad sheyyitten bassof kashshiur. rabbi yehuda omer, im shiyyer kelach echad, somech lo mishshum pea. veim lav, eno noten ella mishshum hefker:
1.4: Kelal amru bappea. kol shehu ochel, venishmar, vegiddulav min haaretz, ulekitato cheachat, umachniso lekiyyum, chayyav bappea. vehattevua vehakkitniyyot bakkelal hazze:
1.5: Uvailan, haog vehecharuvin vehaegozim vehashshekedim vehaggefanim veharimmonim vehazzetim vehattemarim, chayyavin bappea:
1.6: Leolam hu noten mishshum pea ufatur min hammaasrot, ad sheyyemareach. venoten mishshum hefker ufatur min hammaasrot, ad sheyyemareach. umaachil labbehema velachayya velaofot ufatur min hammaasrot, ad sheyyemareach. venotel min haggoren vezorea ufatur min hammaasrot, ad sheyyemareach, divre rabbi akiva. kohen velevi shellakchu et haggoren, hammaasrot shellahem, ad sheyyemareach. hammakdish ufode, chayyav bemaasrot, ad sheyyemareach haggizbar:

2.1: Veellu mafsikin lappea. hannachal, vehashshelulit, vederech hayyachid, vederech harabbim, ushevil harabbim, ushevil hayyachid hakkavua bimot hachamma uvimot haggeshamim, vehabbur, vehannir, vezera acher. vehakkotzer leshachat mafsik, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, eno mafsik, ella im ken charash:
2.2: Ammat hammayim sheenah yechola lehikkatzer keachat, rabbi yehuda omer, mafseket. vechol heharim asher bammader yeaderun, af al pi sheen habbakar yachol laavor bechelav, hu noten pea lakkol:
2.3: Hakkol mafsik lazzeraim, veeno mafsik lailan ella gader. veim haya sear kotesh, eno mafsik, ella noten pea lakkol:
2.4: Velecharuvin, kol haroin ze et ze. amar rabban gamliel, nohagin hayu bet abba, notnin pea achat lazzetim shehayu lahem bechol ruach, velecharuvin, kol haroin ze et ze. rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer mishshemo, af lecharuvin shehayu lahem bechol hair:
2.5: Hazzorea et sadehu min echad, af al pi shehu osehu shete geranot, noten pea achat. zeraah shene minin, af al pi sheasaan goren achat, noten shete feot. hazzorea et sadehu shene mine chittin, asaan goren achat, noten pea achat. shete geranot, noten shete feot:
2.6: Maase shezzara rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa lifne rabban gamliel, vealu lelishkat haggazit veshaalu. amar nachum hallavlar, mekubbal ani merabbi meyasha, shekkibbel meabba, shekkibbel min hazzugot, shekkibbelu min hanneviim, halacha lemoshe missinay, bezorea et sadehu shene mine chittin, im asaan goren achat, noten pea achat. shete geranot, noten shete feot:
2.7: Sade shekketzaruha kutim, ketzaruha listim, kirsemuha nemalim, shevarattah haruach o vehema, petura. katzar chetzyah vekatzru listim chetzyah, petura, shechovat happea bakkama:
2.8: Ketzaruha listim chetzyah vekatzar hu chetzyah, noten pea mimma shekkatzar. katzar chetzyah umachar chetzyah, hallokeach noten pea lakkol. katzar chetzyah vehikdish chetzyah, happode miyyad haggizbar, hu noten pea lakkol:

3.1: Malbenot hattevua shebben hazzetim, bet shammay omrim, pea mikkol achat veechat. bet hillel omrim, meechad al hakkol. umodim, sheim hayu rashe shurot meoravin, shehu noten pea meechad al hakkol:
3.2: Hamenammer et sadehu veshiyyer kelachim lachim, rabbi akiva omer, noten pea mikkol echad veechad. vachachamim omrim, meechad al hakkol. umodim chachamim lerabbi akiva bezorea shevet o chardal bishlosha mekomot, shehu noten pea mikkol echad veechad:
3.3: Hammachalik betzalim lachim lashshuk umekayyem yeveshim laggoren, noten pea laellu leatzman velaellu leatzman. vechen baafunin, vechen bakkerem. hammedel, noten min hameshoar al ma sheshshiyyer. vehammachalik meachat yad, noten min hameshoar al hakkol:
3.4: Haimmahot shel betzalim chayyavot befea, verabbi yose poter. malbenot habbetzalim shebben hayyarak, rabbi yose omer, pea mikkol achat veechat. vachachamim omrim, meachat al hakkol:
3.5: Haachin shechalku, notnin shete feot. chazru venishtattefu, notnin pea achat. shenayim shellakchu et hailan, notnin pea achat. lakach ze tzefono veze deromo, ze noten pea leatzmo, veze noten pea leatzmo. hammocher kilche ilan betoch sadehu, noten pea mikkol echad veechad. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shello shiyyer baal hassade. aval im shiyyer baal hassade, hu noten pea lakkol:
3.6: Rabbi eliezer omer, karka bet rova, chayyevet bappea. rabbi yehoshua omer, haosa satayim. rabbi tarfon omer, shishsha al shishsha tefachim. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, kede liktzor velishnot. vahalacha kidvarav. rabbi akiva omer, karka kol shehu, chayyevet bappea, uvabbikkurim, velichtov alav perozbul, veliknot immo nechasim sheen lahem acharayut bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka:
3.7: Hakkotev nechasav shechiv mera, shiyyer karka kol shehu, mattenato mattana. lo shiyyer karka kol shehu, en mattenato mattana. hakkotev nechasav levanav, vechatav leishto karka kol shehu, ibbeda chetubbatah. rabbi yose omer, im kibbela aleha, af al pi shello chatav lah, ibbeda chetubbatah:
3.8: Hakkotev nechasav leavdo, yatza ven chorin. shiyyer karka kol shehu, lo yatza ven chorin. rabbi shimon omer, leolam hu ven chorin, ad sheyyomar hare chol nechasay netunin leish peloni avdi chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen:

4.1: Happea nittenet bimchubbar lakkarka. bedalit uvedekel, baal habbayit morid umechallek laaniyyim. rabbi shimon omer, af bachalike egozim. afillu tishim vetisha omrim lechallek veechad omer lavoz, laze shomin, sheamar kahalacha:
4.2: Bedalit uvedekel eno chen, afillu tishim vetisha omrim lavoz veechad omer lechallek, laze shomin, sheamar kahalacha:
4.3: Natal miktzat pea uzerakah al hashshear, en lo vah kelum. nafal lo aleha, uferes tallito aleha, maavirin otah hemennu. vechen beleket, vechen beomer hashshichcha:
4.4: Pea en kotzrin otah bemaggalot, veen okrin otah bekardummot, kede shello yakku ish et reehu:
4.5: Shalosh avayot bayyom, bashshachar uvachatzot uvammincha. rabban gamliel omer, lo amru ella kede shello yifchatu. rabbi akiva omer, lo amru ella kede shello yosifu. shel bet namer hayu melakketin al hachevel, venotnim pea mikkol umman veumman:
4.6: Oved kochavim shekkatzar et sadehu veachar kach nitgayyer, patur min halleket umin hashshichcha umin happea. rabbi yehuda mechayyev beshichcha, sheen hashshichcha ella vishat haimmur:
4.7: Hikdish kama ufada kama, chayyav. omarin ufada omarin, chayyav. kama ufada omarin, petura, shebbishat chovatah hayta fetura:
4.8: Kayyotze vo, hammakdish perotav ad shello vau leonat hammaasrot, ufedaan, chayyavin. mishshebbau leonat hammaasrot, ufedaan, chayyavin. hikdishan ad shello nigmeru ugemaran haggizbar, veachar kach pedaan, peturim, shebbishat chovatan hayu feturim:
4.9: Mi shellakat et happea veamar hare zo leish peloni ani, rabbi eliezer omer, zacha lo. vachachamim omrim, yittenenna leani shennimtza rishon. halleket vehashshichcha vehappea shel oved kochavim chayyav bemaasrot, ella im ken hifkir:
4.10: Ezehu leket, hannosher bishat hakketzira. haya kotzer, katzar melo yado, talash melo kumtzo, hikkahu kotz venafal miyyado laaretz, hare hu shel baal habbayit. toch hayyad vetoch hammaggal, laaniyyim. achar hayyad veachar hammaggal, levaal habbayit. rosh hayyad verosh hammaggal, rabbi yishmael omer, laaniyyim. rabbi akiva omer, levaal habbayit:
4.11: Chore hannemalim shebbetoch hakkama, hare hen shel baal habbayit. shelleachar hakkotzrim, haelyonim laaniyyim, vehattachtonim shel baal habbayit. rabbi meir omer, hakkol laaniyyim, shessefek leket, leket:

5.1: Gadish shello lukkat tachtav, kol hannogea baaretz hare hu shel aniyyim. haruach sheppizzera et hoomarim, omdim otah kamma leket hi reuya laasot, venoten laaniyyim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, noten laaniyyim bichde nefila:
5.2: Shibbolet shebbakkatzir veroshah maggia lakkama, im niktzera im hakkama, hare hi shel baal habbayit, veim lav, hare hi shel aniyyim. shibbolet shel leket shennitarva vaggadish, measser shibbolet achat venoten lo. amar rabbi eliezer, vechi heach heani hazze machalif davar shello va virshuto. ella mezakke et heani bechol haggadish, umeasser shibbolet achat venoten lo:
5.3: En megalgelin betofeach, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim mattirin, mippene sheefshar:
5.4: Baal habbayit shehaya over mimmakom lemakom, vetzarich littol leket shichcha ufea umasar ani, yittol, uchesheyyachazor leveto yeshallem, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, ani haya beotah shaa:
5.5: Hammachalif im haaniyyim, beshello patur, uveshel aniyyim chayyav. shenayim shekkibbelu et hassade baarisut, ze noten laze chelko masar ani, veze noten laze chelko masar ani. hamekabbel sade liktzor, asur beleket shichcha ufea umasar ani. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shekkibbel mimmennu lemechetza, lishlish velirvia. aval im amar lo shelish ma sheatta kotzer shellach, muttar beleket uveshichcha uvefea, veasur bemasar ani:
5.6: Hammocher et sadehu, hammocher muttar vehallokeach asur. lo yiskor adam et happoalim al menat sheyyelakket beno acharav. mi sheeno manniach et haaniyyim lilkot, o shehu manniach et echad veechad lo, o shehu mesayyea et echad mehen, hare ze gozel et haaniyyim. al ze neemar (Mishlei 22) al tasseg gevul olim:
5.7: Haomer sheshshechachuhu foalim velo shechacho vaal habbayit, shechacho vaal habbayit velo shechachuhu foalim, amdu aniyyim befanav o shechippuhu vekash, hare ze eno shichcha:
5.8: Hameammer lechovaot ulechumsaot, lacharara veloomarim, en lo shichcha. mimmennu velaggoren, yesh lo shichcha. hameammer laggadish, yesh lo shichcha. mimmennu velaggoren, en lo shichcha. ze hakkelal, kol hameammer lemakom shehu gemar melacha, yesh lo shichcha. mimmennu velaggoren, en lo shichcha. lemakom sheeno gemar melacha, en lo shichcha. mimmennu velaggoren, yesh lo shichcha:

6.1: Bet shammay omrim, hevker laaniyyim, hevker. uvet hillel omrim, eno hefker, ad sheyyufkar af laashirim, kashshemitta. kol amre hassade shel kav kav veechad shel arbaat kabbin ushechacho, bet shammay omrim, eno shichcha. uvet hillel omrim, shichcha:
6.2: Haomer shehu samuch laggafa velaggadish, labbakar velakkelim, ushechacho, bet shammay omrim, eno shichcha. uvet hillel omrim, shichcha:
6.3: Rashe shurot, haomer shekkenegdo mochiach. haomer shehechezik bo leholicho el hair, ushechacho, modim sheeno shichcha:
6.4: Veellu hen rashe shurot. shenayim shehitchilu meemtza hashshura, ze panav latztzafon veze panav laddarom, veshachchu lifnehem uleacharehem, et shellifnehem shichcha, veet shelleacharehem eno shichcha. yachid shehitchil merosh hashshura, veshachach lefanav uleacharav, shellefanav eno shichcha, veshelleacharav shichcha, mippene shehu beval tashuv (Devarim kad). ze hakkelal, kol shehu beval tashuv, shichcha. vesheeno beval tashuv, eno shichcha:
6.5: Shene omarim, shichcha, ushelosha enan shichcha. shene tzibbure zetim vecharuvin, shichcha, ushelosha enan shichcha. shene hutzene fishtan, shichcha, ushelosha enan shichcha. shene gargerim, peret, ushelosha enan peret. shene shibbolim, leket, ushelosha enan leket. ellu kedivre vet hillel. veal kullan bet shammay omrim, shelosha, laaniyyim, vearbaa, levaal habbayit:
6.6: Haomer sheyyesh bo satayim, ushechacho, eno shichcha. shene omarim uvahem satayim, rabban gamliel omer, levaal habbayit. vachachamim omrim, laaniyyim. amar rabban gamliel, vechi merov hoomarim yuppe choach shel baal habbayit o hura kocho. amru lo, yuppe chocho. amar lahem, uma im bizman shehu omer echad uvo satayim ushechacho, eno shichcha, shene omarim uvahem satayim, eno din shello yehe shichcha. amru lo, lo, im amarta beomer echad shehu chegadish, tomar bishne omarim shehen kichrichot:
6.7: Kama sheyyesh bah satayim, ushechachah, enah shichcha. en bah satayim, aval hi reuya laasot satayim, afillu hi shel tofeach, roin otah keillu hi anava shel seorim:
6.8: Hakkama matztzelet et haomer veet hakkama. haomer eno matztzil lo et haomer velo et hakkama. ezo hi kama shehi matztzelet et haomer, kol sheenah shichcha afillu kelach echad:
6.9: Sea tevua akura usea sheenah akura, vechen bailan, vehashshum vehabbetzalim, enan mitztarfin lesatayim, ella shel aniyyim hem. rabbi yose omer, im bat reshut heani baemtza, enan mitztarfin, veim lav, hare ellu mitztarfin:
6.10: Tevua shennittena leshachat o laalumma, vechen baagudde hashshum, vaaguddot hashshum vehabbetzalim, en lahen shichcha. vechol hattemunim baaretz, kegon halluf vehashshum vehabbetzalim, rabbi yehuda omer, en lahem shichcha. vachachamim omrim, yesh lahem shichcha:
6.11: Hakkotzer ballayla vehameammer vehassuma, yesh lahem shichcha. veim haya mitkavven littol et haggas haggas, en lo shichcha. im amar, hare ani kotzer al menat ma sheani shochech ani ettol, yesh lo shichcha:

7.1: Kol zayit sheyyesh lo shem bassade, afillu kezet hannetofa bishato, ushechacho, eno shichcha. bamme devarim amurim, bishmo uvemaasav uvimkomo. bishmo, shehaya shifchoni o veshani. bemaasav, shehu ose harebe. bimkomo, shehu omed betzad haggat o vetzad happirtza. ushear kol hazzetim, shenayim shichcha, ushelosha enan shichcha. rabbi yose omer, en shichcha lazzetim:
7.2: Zayit shennimtza omed ben shalosh shurot shel shene malbenim ushechacho, eno shichcha. zayit sheyyesh bo satayim, ushechacho, eno shichcha. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shello hitchil bo. aval im hitchil bo, afillu kezet hannetofa bishato, ushechacho, yesh lo shichcha. kol zeman sheyyesh lo tachtav, yesh lo verosho. rabbi meir omer, mishshettelech hammachave:
7.3: Ezehu feret, hannosher bishat habbetzira. haya votzer, akatz et haeshkol, husbach bealim, nafal miyyado laaretz venifrat, hare hu shel baal habbayit. hammanniach et hakkalkala tachat haggefen beshaa shehu votzer, hare ze gozel et haaniyyim, al ze neemar (Mishlei 22) al tasseg gevul olim:
7.4: Ezohi olelet. kol sheen lah lo chatef velo natef. im yesh lah katef o natef, shel baal habbayit, im safek, laaniyyim. olelet shebbaarkubba, im nikretzet im haeshkol, hare hi shel baal habbayit, veim lav, hare hi shel aniyyim. garger yechidi, rabbi yehuda omer, eshkol. vachachamim omrim, olelet:
7.5: Hammedel baggefanim, keshem shehu medel betoch shello, ken hu medel beshel aniyyim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, beshello hu rashshay, veeno rashshay beshel aniyyim:
7.6: Kerem revai, bet shammay omrim, en lo chomesh, veen lo viur. bet hillel omrim, yesh lo. bet shammay omrim, yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot, vehaaniyyim podin leatzman. uvet hillel omrim, kullo laggat:
7.7: Kerem shekkullo ollot, rabbi eliezer omer, levaal habbayit. rabbi akiva omer, laaniyyim. amar rabbi eliezer, ki tivtzor lo teolel (Devarim kad), im en batzir, minnayin ollot. amar lo rabbi akiva, vecharmecha lo teolel (Vayikra 19), afillu chullo ollot, im ken lamma neemar ki tivtzor lo teolel, en laaniyyim baollot kodem habbatzir:
7.8: Hammakdish karmo ad shello nodu vo haollot, en haollot laaniyyim. mishshennodu vo haollot, haollot laaniyyim. rabbi yose omer, yittenu sechar giddulav lahekdesh. eze hi shichcha bearis, kol sheeno yachol lifshot et yado velittelah, uverogliyyot, mishsheyyaavor hemenna:

8.1: Meematay kol adam muttarin beleket. mishsheyyelchu hannamoshot. beferet veollot, mishsheyyelchu haaniyyim bakkerem veyavou. uvezetim, mishshettered revia sheniyya. amar rabbi yehuda, vahalo yesh sheenam moskin et zetehem ella leachar revia sheniyya. ella chede sheyyehe heani yotze velo yehe mevi bearbaa issarot:
8.2: Neemanim al halleket veal hashshichcha veal happea bishatan, veal masar ani bechol shenato. uven levi neeman leolam. veenan neemanin ella al davar shebbene adam nohagin ken:
8.3: Neemanin al hachittim, veen neemanin al hakkemach velo al happat. neemanin al hasseora shel orez, veen neemanin alav ben chay ben mevushshal. neemanin al happol, veen neemanin al haggerisin, lo chayyim velo mevushshalin. neemanin al hashshemen lomar shel masar ani hu, veen neemanin alav lomar shel zete nikkuf hu:
8.4: Neemanim al hayyarak chay, veen neemanim al hamevushshal, ella im ken haya lo davar muat, shekken derech baal habbayit lihyot motzi millefaso:
8.5: En pochatin laaniyyim baggoren mechatzi kav chittim vekav seorim. rabbi meir omer, chatzi kav. kav vachetzi chussemin, vekav gerogarot, o mane devela. rabbi akiva omer, peras. chatzi log yayin. rabbi akiva omer, reviit. reviit shemen. rabbi akiva omer, sheminit. ushear kol happerot, amar abba shaul, kede sheyyimkerem veyikkach bahem mezon shete seuddot:
8.6: Midda zo amura bechohanim uvilviyyim uveyisreelim. haya matztzil, notel mechetza venoten mechetza. haya lo davar muat, noten lifnehem, vehen mechallekin benehem:
8.7: En pochatin leani haover mimmakom lemakom mikkikkar befunedyon, mearba sein besela. lan, notnin lo parnasat lina. shavat, notnin lo mezon shalosh seuddot. mi sheyyesh lo mezon shete seuddot, lo yittol min hattamchuy. mezon arba esre seuddot, lo yittol min hakkuppa. vehakkuppa nigbet bishnayim, umitchalleket bishlosha:
8.8: Mi sheyyesh lo matayim zuz, lo yittol leket shichcha ufea umasar ani. hayu lo matayim chaser dinar, afillu elef notnin lo cheachat, hare ze yittol. hayu memushkanim levaal chovo o lichtubbat ishto, hare ze yittol. en mechayyevin oto limkor et beto veet kele tashmisho:
8.9:
Mi sheyyesh lo chamishshim zuz vehu nose venoten bahem, hare ze lo yittol. vechol mi sheeno tzarich littol venotel, eno niftar min haolam ad sheyyitztarech labberiyyot. vechol mi shetztzarich littol veeno notel, eno met min hazzikna ad sheyyefarnes acherim mishshello, vealav hakkatuv omer baruch haggever asher yivtach baAdonai vehaya Adonai mivtacho (yirmeya 17). vechen dayyan sheddan din emet laamitto. vechol mi sheeno lo chigger, velo suma, velo fisseach, veose atzmo keachad mehem, eno met min hazzikna ad sheyyihye keechad mehem, shenneemar (Devarim 16) tzedek tzedek tirdof. vechol dayyan shellokeach shochad umatte et haddin, eno met min hazzikna ad sheenav kehot, shenneemar (Shemot 23) veshochad lo tikkach ki hashshochad yeavver pikchim vegomer:
selik massechet pea
